A '''steel pickaxe''' is the [[Steel equipment|steel]] [[Tools#Pickaxe|pickaxe]], made by smithing an [[iron pickaxe]] with [[steel alloy]]. It mines only one speed faster than iron, but its 3000 durability is six times higher, and it can mine obsidian.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade needs no template. Enchantments on the iron item carry over; where both items have the same enchantment, the higher level is kept.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===
It breaks pickaxe blocks at speed 8. It has none of the iron pickaxe's restrictions, so it also harvests obsidian, crying obsidian and ender chests at speed 8.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/steel_pickaxe.json}}</ref> The 1.12.1-alpha notes say only diamond, electrum and adamant can mine obsidian, but steel was left out of that rule.

The pack also makes glass, glass panes, glowstone, sea lanterns and mob heads pickaxe blocks.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/pickaxe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|3}} damage at an attack speed of 1.2. Steel tools reuse the removed stone tools' item IDs, so where the item sets no attack attributes of its own it keeps the stone tool's values.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[iron ingot]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

== Notes ==
* The hand-written tooltip hides the real attributes and shows attack damage 4 (real value 3).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/steel_pickaxe.json}}</ref>
